prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) and highest seasonality correlation (0.7616), making it the pattern champion despite higher RMSE. CWT_catboost leads overall RMSE (133.35) with exceptional late-horizon performance (102.21), while ONLY_CWT_rf excels early (130.33). The extreme RMSE spread (23.58 ratio) and high seasonality variance suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while managing model disagreement and concept drift.
